groups.title: AI chat, agents, and routines
new: Chat: press Cmd+E to talk about a page, with separate conversations for each tab.
Attach tabs to chat and inspect what AI sees before sending.
Ask AI directly from the command bar and continue the answer in chat.
Agent mode: review a plan and let Whimsy carry out a browser task.
Connect outside agents and review their actions in Activity.
Routines: schedule tasks or run them when you visit a site or return to the browser.
Updates in the command bar collect watch results and routine notifications, with reminders for later.
Connect apps through MCP in Settings and bring Granola context into chat.
Save reusable AI commands with prompts that include page or selected text.
Memory: let chat remember facts you share, with controls to inspect, edit, export, or delete them.
Related results find previously visited pages by meaning.
Summarize pages and PDFs with links back to the passages used.
Summarize videos with chapter links, transcripts, and key quotes.
Draft replies and fill visible form fields with AI, with Undo for written replies.
Describe changes to a page and keep its edited appearance.
Translate pages with AI while keeping their links.
Get scam warnings before entering sensitive details on unfamiliar sites.
Compare products by their true price from the address bar.
Hold Fn to dictate, or hold Cmd+K to speak a command.
Select, copy, find, and translate text inside images.
Listen to pages with macOS voices and sentence highlighting.
Type : in the command bar to find and insert an emoji.
improved: AI settings bring providers, models, permissions, and feature controls onto one page.
Chat answers include citations, tables, and research reports you can open in a tab.
Link previews can show a short AI summary.
Hover over the chat dock edge to peek at a conversation.
Expand memory chips to see facts used or saved, and remove saved facts in place.
The command bar finds open tabs across spaces and profiles, labeled with their space.
Fire lets you choose spaces, data types, and time ranges, including chats and agent activity.
Video speed ranges from 1/16× to 16×, with a button to return to your default.
Find can open as a floating card with an option to ask AI about the page.
Agents ask before visiting new sites, sending forms, or using connector tools that make changes.
Agents reuse open tabs and check whether a task succeeded before reporting completion.
Cookie banner blocking uses updated rules.
fixed: Chat memory skips invented and repeated facts.
Chat suggestion chips send their question when clicked.
Mouse back and forward buttons work at the Library edge.
Tab status text fits within its row.
Read aloud buttons stay clickable as their controls expand.
Typing in sidebar fields no longer triggers tab navigation or deletion.
Tidy Tabs leaves agent task folders intact.
Library sections keep their order when turned off and back on.
Pages scroll normally beneath an open link preview.

groups.title: Easel, form drafts, and site controls
new: Easel: arrange live page captures and shapes on a canvas, kept separately for each profile.
Form drafts: restore what you typed after reloading or reopening a tab.
This Site controls remember zoom, autoplay, Reader View, full screen, and user agent choices.
Battery Saver reduces background activity, with automatic and manual controls.
Inspect fonts, colors, contrast, spacing, and what a page is built with.
Open a private command bar with Cmd+Option+T.
Hide spaces and bring them back from Show Hidden Spaces.
Choose whether private tabs and locked spaces lock as soon as you leave them.
Call Options let microphone and camera buttons mute the call or block the device.
Live captions work for calls, including in Picture-in-Picture.
Pause the VPN for a call and restore its site rule when the call ends.
Connect OpenAI or Gemini with an API key, or sign in with a ChatGPT or Claude plan.
View Source has a line wrap option.
improved: Ctrl+Tab shows recent tabs across spaces, with space labels and faster opening for large tab collections.
Mini Whimsy supports multiple page tabs and a searchable Open in Space list.
Quick Notes save as you type and keep notes for the current page easy to find.
Library Screenshots uses a thumbnail grid with adjustable sizes.
Screenshots offer portrait capture, blur, and redaction after capture.
The shortcut cheat sheet is searchable, and floating panels have draggable headers.
Settings search highlights matching rows and lets Return step through results.
Menu settings show submenus in place and use the menus’ own names.
Toasts stack without covering one another and offer clearer actions and Undo.
Option+drag a link lasso to open its links as tabs or make a folder.
Live folders offer Resync to restore tabs you closed by hand.
VPN location and site rules are available from the address bar.
Reader View keeps reading time, sharing, and saved page zoom.
Press a shortcut again to run the browser command when a page uses the first press.
Essential tabs have their own unread badge switch.
Balloon Dash keeps running when you reconnect until you choose Reload.
Shift+Enter opens the top search result directly, with Search Deck available as an option.
Toasts no longer pause for macOS Focus modes.
fixed: Reopening a pinned tab or Essential restores the page you left and its back history.
Private command bar suggestions stay separate from normal browsing.
Ctrl+Tab keeps private and normal tabs apart.
Locked tabs require unlocking before they can be moved, copied, or shared.
Hidden spaces stay out of swipes and move menus.
Tabs moved between profiles keep their isolation and select the reopened page.
Sign-in and extension popups work in Mini Whimsy.
Mini Whimsy stays at the normal window level.
Pasted screenshots upload once through the page’s own upload controls.
Call controls follow your microphone and camera without affecting other participants.
Cmd+T starts with an empty command bar, even after a quick close and reopen.
Screenshots open centered, save once, and accept Enter to capture or Esc to cancel.
Split layout shortcuts no longer pull in an extra Essential.
Previously visited intranet addresses open as addresses instead of searches.
Notes and Easel live blocks load sites with stricter sign-in protections.
Per-profile download folders work correctly.
Private screenshots stay out of the Library.
Fire and history clearing also remove matching archived and snoozed tabs.

groups.title: Live captions, menus and focus
new: Live captions: on-device speech-to-text for videos that lack captions.
Menus settings: turn individual right-click menu items on or off.
Focus integration: Whimsy toasts pause while a macOS Focus mode is on.
Paste guard: warns before pasting secrets or sensitive tokens into web pages.
Cast web video directly to AirPlay receivers from the View menu.
Local network discovery: Bonjour finds local development servers automatically.
Split View headers: each pane has a header menu to separate, swap, or close panes.
Redact tool: black out sensitive text or images before capturing screenshots.
Teach once: helpful hints the first time a shortcut can help you.
Turn the Private Space into a permanent space with the New Space dialog.
improved: Fire button offers simpler choices to Fire in This Profile or Fire Everywhere.
Linear live folders work with your signed-in session without an API key.
Portrait captures take mobile-sized screenshots of any page.
Changelog dev build IDs show only on the Dev update channel.
fixed: Split view restored layouts cleanly reconnect without closing sibling panes.
Quick window address fields keep controls centered and clear of traffic lights.

groups.title: Profiles, link hints and audio controls
new: Profiles: separate your personal, work, and school browsing with isolated logins, passwords, history, and extensions.
Audio indicator on tabs: see which tab is playing sound, with one-click mute.
Link hints: press Cmd+J to show letter badges on links and click them from the keyboard.
Zap: press Cmd+Shift+X to erase distracting banners or overlays from any page.
Instant result: press Shift+Enter in the command bar to open the top search result immediately.
Search Deck: flip through search results side-by-side in a Glance view.
Trails: branch back and forward through pages you navigated away from.
Page actions: address bar pill offering quick actions based on page data.
Copy as Markdown and view .md and .csv files directly in the browser.
Link lasso: Cmd+drag over links on a page to select and open them together.
Generate QR codes for any webpage from the context menu.
improved: Already-open tabs: entering an open tab's URL in the command bar switches straight to it.
Unified Settings: cleaner navigation combining Appearance and Tab Management without lost options.
Linear and Jira live folders let you customize which issue statuses are shown.
fixed: Mini Whimsy controls sit flush in the address strip and traffic lights no longer flicker.
Essentials and pinned tabs drop extraneous borders and place unread badges on the tile corner.

groups.title: AI, seasonal touches and email aliases
new: AI features: ask questions about the current page, preview pages in 5 seconds, and watch pages for changes.
Seasonal touches: dynamic seasonal gradients on tab loading and festive balloon costumes.
Email aliases: generate Firefox Relay and iCloud Hide My Email addresses in form fields.
Handoff: pick up your active web page on your iPhone or other Apple devices.
Offline Playlist: queue up video files to watch offline.
Liquid Glass effect for translucent sidebars and toolbars.
improved: Tidy tabs cleans up verbose page titles when you pin a tab.
Library rail icons animate smoothly when clicked.
Reduced motion support across animations, balloons, and page decor.
Enhanced privacy protections for background readers and AI previews.

groups.title: Mini Whimsy, calendar and history
new: Mini Whimsy: lightweight floating windows for external links, with easy space switching.
Space-aware History: see which space you visited each page in, and filter History by space.
Next Meeting: see your upcoming calendar events in the sidebar and join calls with one click.
Whimsy homepage (about:whimsy) with quick links, keyboard shortcuts, and Arc import.
This changelog, showing every build's updates in one place.
Connect Claude: interact with your tabs using a private, token-free connection.
Per-space VPN: protect your connection across your whole browser or only in selected spaces.
Balloon Dash: an arcade mini-game when you're offline or waiting for a page to load.
Recent tabs in the command bar, plus offline search bangs.
Adjust Glance sizes to Compact, Standard, or Wide.
People cards: preview GitHub, LinkedIn, and X profiles by hovering over links.
improved: Custom space icons featuring the full set of colorful glyphs.
Video speed controller: click the speed badge on any video to pick or type any playback speed.
Manage which extensions run in each space.
Tree tabs let you drag tabs to reparent them or collapse entire tab branches.

groups.title: Splits, tabs and library
new: Open links in a side-by-side Split View, swap panes, or expand a pane to take the whole window.
Quick windows: open links from other apps in a focused window without cluttering your spaces.
Archive tabs automatically after 12 or 24 hours, and restore closed tabs with Cmd+Z.
Snooze tabs until later today, tomorrow, or a custom time.
Lock spaces with Touch ID or your system password.
Library sections for Notes, Downloads, Finder folders, Screenshots, and Archive.
A Private Space for quick private browsing, and private tabs.
Fire button to quickly close tabs and wipe recent browsing data.
System menu bar item to quickly jump to open tabs and spaces.
improved: Tree style tab grouping with collapsible branches.
Clean print mode that removes site clutter before printing.
Heavy tab warnings when a page uses excessive CPU.

groups.title: Sound, video and reading
new: Mute background tabs, and remember sites you've muted.
Set a tab's volume and a video's playback speed.
Picture-in-picture opens when you leave a video and closes when you come back.
Take screenshots, edit a page's text, and copy and paste on sites that block it.
Find missing pages in the Internet Archive.
See information about any image.
Translate the text you've selected.
improved: Reader view lets you pick its typography and shows reading time.
PDFs can follow dark mode.
Find starts with the text you've selected.
Update settings now live in About Whimsy.

groups.title: Spaces, your way
new: Drop tabs on a space's icon to move them there.
Open a link in another space from the context menu.
Pick theme colors by hex value, with transparency, menu icons and your own interface font.
improved: Each space remembers the tab you were last on.
Search for a space's emoji, or hide the space switcher.

groups.title: Tidier tabs
new: Color your folders.
A thin line shows a page loading.
Pinned tabs and Essentials show unread counts and update dots.
Group tabs by site.
improved: The New Tab button can sit at the bottom of the sidebar.

groups.title: Links and privacy
new: Copy rich links, or links to several tabs at once.
Turn off the browser's AI features in Settings.
Duplicate a tab with Cmd+Shift+D, and pin or unpin it with Cmd+D.
improved: Tracking bits are removed from links, and cookie banners are declined, by default.
Private windows are easier to tell apart.
New tabs open below the current one, inside its folder.
Choose how tab titles wrap, and dim sleeping tabs.

groups.title: Hello, Whimsy
new: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab.
App icons to choose from.
Zoom the whole interface.
See your pull requests apart from your team's.
Automatic updates.
